'''Trace Lyson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lyson resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. During that time, [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in the region of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] had become very hostile and directly threatened the city.<ref name="SWG:TJO" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of Trace Lyson's associates by the name [[Trehla Keelo]] discovered information regarding the recent activities of Tusken near Mos Eisley. After a skirmish with the Tuskens in [[Junktown]], she dispatched a spacer to travel from Mos Eisley to Mos Espa in order to inform Trace Lyson about the situation.<ref name="SWG:TJO" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanMale.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Trace Lyson]]
Trace Lyson was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TJO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Trace Lyson was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of an introductory questline for new players who spawned on Tatooine right after the completion of the "New Player Tutorial".<ref name="SWG:TJO" /> Trace Lyson's quest was removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], 2005.<ref name="SWG:2005" />
